notes: Client TUN path. zfstack uses StackConfig::client + splice + vnet-hdr + driver thread. sing-box go is the 1.15 default stack; official linux-amd64 tags no longer ship with_gvisor. lwip is a C TUN proxy using upstream lwIP 2.2.1 (NO_SYS=1, TCP_MSS 8191). hev is hev-socks5-tunnel plus a local SOCKS5 override (extra userspace hop — connect/short p50 ~204 ms is handshake, not stack RTT). Idle 4000-conn cells were re-run after zfbench raised RLIMIT_NOFILE to 262144; the first pass hit EMFILE at ~510 connections under the sudo default of 1024.
